characters.name: Thomas Graves
characters.special: SPECIAL ABILITY (BLACKOUT PHASE): During each Blackout, if you are NOT Detained, the Host wakes you alone to secretly read ONE guest's Sealed Detention Card for 12 seconds!
characters.persona: Dignified, observant butler who notices everything and speaks quietly. You have served Ravenshollow Manor since 1999.
characters.secret: You skimmed small sums from the wine cellar budget for your sister's medical bills (making you nervous about wine questions), though you are innocent of murder. You also brought a miniature field chemistry kit in your bag, which you will use between Acts II and III to produce Exhibit F (testing the wine vs. Arthur's cuff).
characters.clue: At 8:40 PM you poured a piping-hot cup of chamomile tea in the Study—by 9:02 PM the untouched cup was barely lukewarm. You also saw Arthur's watch smashed at 8:48 PM.
characters.detention: Searched from Graves's Coat Pocket: Tonight's butler log: '8:40 PM — Poured hot cup of chamomile tea in Study. 9:02 PM — Cup untouched and barely lukewarm; watch crystal smashed at 8:48 PM.'

dialogues.line: "I did a headcount in the Grand Hall when the clock struck nine. You weren't there. Where exactly were you when the lights went out?"

"Wait a second—Exhibit D's Study re-inspection shows Arthur was slumped face-down at 9:01 PM, yet you claimed you saw his pale lips the instant the lights returned—and the puddle was odorless water, not wine!"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "My field test found chloral hydrate—sleeping powder—in the red wine decanter. Tell the truth right now, or you're getting my final vote!"

characters.name: Dr. Julian Mercer
characters.persona: Calm, composed physician who has looked after Arthur's health for years and was standing in the Grand Hall at 8:55 PM.
characters.secret: You quietly wrote Arthur an off-the-books prescription for severe insomnia last month against hospital guidelines—embarrassing, not lethal.
characters.clue: You know Arthur's heart was stable at dinner and that fast-acting Aconite is completely odorless—unlike cyanide's bitter-almond smell.
characters.detention: Searched from Dr. Mercer's Medical Bag: A leather vial case with 6 sealed Heart Tonic vials (all intact) and an off-the-books insomnia prescription for Lord Arthur.

dialogues.line: "As Arthur's physician, I can swear his heart was completely stable at dinner. Whatever killed him tonight behind that locked door was fast-acting foul play, not natural failure."

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Something about that 'bitter-almond' claim makes zero medical sense. Cyanide smells of bitter almonds, yes—but Exhibit D's Study re-inspection says the puddle had no scent at all! An odorless plant poison fits far better than cyanide."

dialogues.target: Say to Sebastian Cole (#11) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Exhibit F confirms concentrated Aconite—fatal in two to three minutes. If Arthur collapsed at 8:48 PM, it entered his system right around 8:45 PM from whatever he carried into the Study!"

characters.name: Celeste Moreau
characters.persona: Brilliant, fiercely proud master clockmaker and Arthur's former fiancée (he stole your escapement design 30 years ago). Invited to appraise the Chronos Automaton.
characters.secret: RED HERRING! At 7:58 PM, you snuck into the Dining & Sideboard and put CHLORAL HYDRATE (non-lethal sleeping powder) into Arthur's 1998 Bordeaux wine decanter before a glass was carried up to his Study, then slipped into the Study around 8:05 PM to locate the New Will! You're terrified you killed him—until Exhibit F proves he never drank the wine!
characters.clue: You know the Chronos Automaton can be programmed to play a pre-recorded brass cylinder at 8:55 PM AND drop its 5-lb counterweight at 9:00 PM—proving Arthur could have died BEFORE 8:55! Also: once Exhibit F drops in Act III, confess to the sleeping powder so the room stops wasting votes on you and hunts the real killer!
characters.detention: Searched from Celeste Moreau's Pocket: A folded white paper packet labeled 'Chloral Hydrate (Sleep Aid)' and a desperate note about stealing the unsigned New Will.

dialogues.line: "Keep your voice down! Yes, I stepped into the Study around 8:05 PM to talk to Arthur—he wasn't even there! Why is everyone blaming the wine?"
"Between us—did Lord Arthur drink any of that red wine tonight? Harriet Vance-Cole claimed it smelled of poison, and I'm worried..."

dialogues.target: Confess to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Fine! I put sleeping powder—chloral hydrate—in the Bordeaux decanter in the Dining & Sideboard at 7:58 PM to steal the Will! NOT Aconite! And Exhibit F proves he NEVER DRANK THE WINE! I'm a thief, not a murderer!"

characters.name: Harriet Vance-Cole
characters.special: YOU ARE THE KILLER! Win by avoiding indictment in the Final Verdict (frame Nadia Vance #18 or Celeste Moreau #7!). Your Shadow Team allies: Nadia Vance (#18). During Blackouts, wake up to Intimidate 1 guest OR Plant a False Lead.

characters.secret: In 2008, YOU were behind "2008 Judicial Inquiry — Sealed Bribery Docket" (signed "H.V."). Tonight: at 8:15 PM you rigged the Chronos Automaton (8:55 PM voice + 9:00 PM carafe smash); at 8:35 PM you blackmailed Nadia Vance (#18) to cut the generator at 9:00 PM; at 8:42 PM you handed Arthur a private medicinal bitters flask laced with concentrated Aconite (he died at 8:48 PM). You stood next to Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) at 8:55 PM for an alibi, then slipped up at 9:01 PM by claiming you saw his chalk-pale lips (he was face-down!), smelled 'bitter-almond wine,' and lied about the 8:48 PM watch.

characters.detention: Searched from Harriet Vance-Cole's Effects: A folded dinner napkin smudged with faint fireplace soot and an unsigned note in Harriet Vance-Cole's handwriting: "Speak to Arthur privately before the 9:00 PM announcement—he cannot open that 2008 file tonight."

dialogues.line: "I was standing right beside Dr. Julian Mercer in the Grand Hall at 8:55 PM when Arthur was shouting! With guests coming and going all evening, who had access to Arthur's Bordeaux decanter tonight? Someone clearly poisoned that wine before nine."
"I rolled Arthur over at 9:01 to check his pulse—pure reflex! Don't get distracted by a half-burned 2008 page; ask Nadia Vance why the lights conveniently died at nine!"
"Yes, I handed Arthur a private medicinal bitters flask at 8:42 PM—completely harmless! If his watch stopped at 8:48, he must have dropped it before arguing at 8:55. Don't fall for a frame-up!"

"The wine glass on Arthur's desk was completely full. What troubles me is the single cup of hot chamomile tea poured at 8:40 PM—by 9:02 PM, it was untouched and barely lukewarm!"
"Think back! At 8:42 PM in the Grand Hall, I personally watched Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) hand Arthur a private medicinal bitters flask—and Arthur carried it straight up to his locked Study!"

characters.name: Father Silas Ward

characters.secret: Last Tuesday, Arthur confessed he had spent eighteen years 'shielding a guilty soul from a 2008 sin.' Bound by the Seal of Confession, you speak in pointed truths.
characters.clue: You know Arthur's New Will was his final act of penance to expose the true culprit from 2008.
characters.detention: Searched from Father Silas's Breviary: A Nov 14 bookmark in Arthur's hand: 'Father, pray for me. On the 19th I am ending eighteen years of silence about Archive Box #4.'

dialogues.line: "I have been Arthur's confessor for twenty years. Last Tuesday he came to me burdened by eighteen years of shielding a guilty soul from a 2008 sin he could no longer keep buried."

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit C]:
dialogues.line: "I am bound by the Seal of Confession, so listen carefully: Arthur's New Will was his final act of penance to unseal Archive Box #4. The guilty soul feared the truth of 2008 far more than losing an inheritance."

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "Look past the noise of the 9:00 PM blackout and read Exhibit E with clear eyes. The person who truly belonged to that 2008 sin is the one who silenced Arthur before he could sign."

characters.name: Gideon Thorne
characters.persona: Slick, ruthless business rival invited tonight so Arthur could gloat over the Chronos Automaton.
characters.secret: You are trying to buy stolen Vance Precision schematics on the sly—corporate espionage, NOT murder!
characters.clue: At 8:38 PM, someone panicked and whispered to you that they were being blackmailed into cutting the manor's power at 9:00 PM sharp!
characters.detention: Searched from Gideon's Briefcase: A $150,000 cashier's check for 'consulting services' and a note: '8:38 PM — Blackout at 9:00 PM was forced by blackmail!'

dialogues.line: "A word in private! At 8:38 PM I saw you looking panicked in the hall and heard you mutter about being blackmailed into cutting the manor's power at 9:00 PM sharp. What the hell is going on?"

"Arthur and I were business rivals, not enemies to the death. If you want to know why the lights died at nine, stop blaming the storm—someone in this house blackmailed an accomplice into pulling the breaker!"
"A man is dead! Whoever blackmailed you tonight used your 9:00 PM blackout as cover for a murder that happened twelve minutes earlier—save yourself before you take the fall!"

characters.name: Nadia Vance
characters.special: YOU ARE ON THE SHADOW TEAM! You are allied with Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) and win ONLY if the Killer escapes indictment in the Final Verdict. Wake up with the Shadow Team during Blackout Phases.

characters.secret: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) caught your private scandal and blackmailed you into cutting the basement generator breaker for 15 seconds at 9:00 PM sharp! You didn't know Harriet Vance-Cole was going to murder Arthur, but if Harriet Vance-Cole goes down, you go to prison as an accessory. Worse, your initials (N.V.) appear on the burned Exhibit C audit log from 2008—even though you had no access in 2008!
characters.clue: STRATEGY: Deflect suspicion onto Celeste Moreau (#7) and defend Harriet Vance-Cole's (#8) 8:55 PM Grand Hall alibi!
characters.detention: Searched from Nadia Vance's Belongings: Heavy rubber-insulated electrical gloves (smelling of ozone from the generator breaker) and an unsigned blackmail note: '9:00 PM sharp. Fifteen seconds of dark, or your secret goes to the police.'

dialogues.line: "I wasn't in the Grand Hall at nine because I heard a shutter banging near the basement stairs. Stop pointing fingers at me when everyone knows Celeste Moreau was desperate to stop that Will tonight!"

dialogues.target: Say to Sebastian Cole (#11) [after Exhibit C]:

"I didn't touch any poison and I didn't rig that Automaton! Look at who stood to gain from the unsigned Will—and remember Harriet Vance-Cole was in the Grand Hall at 8:55!"

characters.name: Alistair Finch
characters.persona: Theatrical, scatterbrained ghostwriter living at the manor for two months to write Arthur's tell-all memoirs.
characters.secret: Arthur fired you yesterday for peeking at his sealed Archive Box #4 (making you look bitter!), though you are innocent of murder.
characters.clue: Two days ago, you helped Arthur record Chapter 12 of his memoirs onto a blank brass cylinder—word-for-word: 'You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!'
characters.detention: Searched from Alistair's Notebook: Nov 17 shorthand notes: 'Recorded Arthur's Ch. 12 quote onto brass cylinder (You've gone too far! I'm calling the police!). Subject: 2008 Archive Box #4 cover-up.'

dialogues.line: "Don't you find it extraordinary? The exact words we heard Arthur shouting at 8:55 PM—'You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!'—are word-for-word from Chapter 12 of the memoir he dictated to me two days ago!"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit D]:

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit E]:

exhibits.title: Exhibit A — Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• Door & Window: Heavy oak double-door bolted from the inside; cliff window latched inside.
  • The Body: Lord Arthur Vance slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • On the Desk: Unsigned New Will; a crystal wine glass; a single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); a broken pocket watch.
  • On the Floor: Shattered glass beside a heavy 5-lb brass counterweight in a pool of spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Exhibit B — Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

exhibits.title: Exhibit C — Charred Audit Log ('H.V.' / 'N.V.')
exhibits.html:
VANCE PRECISION INSTRUMENTS — CONFIDENTIAL AUDIT
ARCHIVE BOX #4 (SLATED FOR RELEASE WITH NEW WILL)
-------------------------------------------------
SUBJECT:   2008 Judicial Inquiry — Sealed Bribery Docket
FINDING:   Key evidence suppressed in a 2008 wrongful-death inquest; docket FALSIFIED

exhibits.title: Exhibit D — Chronos Automaton, Wax Cylinder & Study Re-Inspection
exhibits.html:
• Phonograph Drum: Plays a removable brass wax cylinder at a scheduled minute. Currently set to 8:55 PM.
  • Release Cam: Drops a 5-lb brass counterweight at 9:00 PM (shifted 2 inches to strike the water carafe).
  • Cylinder Label: Reads "9:00 PM Gala Greeting" — hastily glued over a scratched-out title: "Memoir Draft — Confrontation."
  • Study Re-Inspection (Clear Light): The crystal wine glass on the desk is completely full & untouched; the shattered glass on the floor is a water carafe in clear, odorless liquid (zero wine, zero bitter-almond scent). Desk-blotter impressions confirm Arthur collapsed face-down, facing away from the door until Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) rolled him over.

exhibits.title: Exhibit E — 2008 Dossier Ledger & Horologist Journal
exhibits.html:
• Selected 2008 Archive Records:
    • Thomas Graves (#3): Estate Steward & Keyholder, Ravenshollow (1999–present)
    • Celeste Moreau (#7): Master Appraiser, Geneva Horology Guild (2008)
    • Harriet Vance-Cole (#8): County Magistrate, Coastal District (2004–2008)
    • Margot Bell (#10): Investigative Reporter, Boston Chronicle (2007–2008)
    • Father Silas Ward (#13): Parish Treasurer, St. Jude's Coastal Parish (2005–2008)
    • Nadia Vance (#18): No access to Archive Box #4 in 2008 (outside the 2008 incident window).
  • Arthur's Horologist Journal (Nov 15): "A clockmaker whose own pocket watch loses a single second is a fraud. My gold chronometer is calibrated daily to the U.S. Naval Observatory signal. It has not drifted by half a second in eleven years."

exhibits.title: Exhibit F — Field Toxicology Report
exhibits.html:
• Red Wine (Dining Sideboard Decanter & Untouched Study Glass): Positive for Chloral Hydrate (non-lethal sleeping sedative). Arthur never drank it.
  • Residue on Arthur's Lips & Cuff: Positive for Concentrated Aconite (fast-acting, completely odorless cardiac poison; fatal in 2–3 minutes) — matching trace contact from a private medicinal bitters flask.
  • Floor Puddle: Plain spring water. Zero wine, zero bitter-almond odor.

exhibits.html:

"9:00 PM sharp. Pull the main breaker. Don't let anyone see you. — C.M."

exhibits.title: False Lead #2 — Anonymous Library Rumor (Blackout Action)

Slipped under the Library door during the blackout:

"Check the Dining & Sideboard! Someone wiped down the Bordeaux decanter left on the sideboard with an almond-scented handkerchief right before 9:00 PM."

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

act1.sub: Read Public Opener, unlock Exhibits A & B, mingle (7m), then Vote (3m) & Blackout (1m).
act1.html:
Sebastian Cole (#11)
"Nobody touch a thing! The oak door was bolted from the inside, and the window drops eighty feet to the rocks. How on earth could someone kill him in a locked room?"
Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
"He was shouting at someone at 8:55! We all heard him! Then at 9:00 the lights went out and—my God, was that a gunshot?"
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"There is no bullet wound. It was poison! The moment the lights came back on at 9:01, I saw Arthur's chalk-pale lips and smelled that unmistakable bitter-almond scent from the spilled wine. He died right around nine."
Sebastian Cole (#11)
"Begging your pardon, but when I stepped beside the desk, I noticed Lord Arthur's pocket watch had smashed on the corner—its hands were stopped at 8:48."
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Ah, yes, I closed the lid so it wouldn't upset everyone. Arthur's watch always ran twelve minutes slow—he told me so himself just yesterday."
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Slow or not, the New Will is still on his desk—unsigned. Whoever wanted Arthur dead before 9:00 PM is standing in this room."

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-6018)

The Killer: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
The Accomplice (Shadow Team): Nadia Vance (#18)
The Inspector: Thomas Graves (#3)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the private medicinal bitters flask handed to him by Harriet Vance-Cole (#8) at 8:42 PM.

Celeste Moreau (#7) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Nadia Vance (#18) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the private medicinal bitters flask; (3) Harriet Vance-Cole slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C flagged both "H.V." and "N.V.", but Exhibit E clears Nadia Vance (no 2008 access) and ties Harriet Vance-Cole directly to 2008 Judicial Inquiry — Sealed Bribery Docket (County Magistrate, Coastal District (2004–2008))!
